summary: Shows enabling the debugger globally with enable_task_debugger = True in ansible.cfg or ANSIBLE_ENABLE_TASK_DEBUGGER=True, which invokes it on every failed task unless disabled at a finer level.
questions: How do I enable the Ansible debugger in ansible.cfg?
What environment variable turns on the task debugger?
Does the global debugger setting trigger on every failure?

answer_card.title: Enabling the debugger globally
answer_card.answer_md:
```ini
[defaults]
enable_task_debugger = True
```

or

```shell
ANSIBLE_ENABLE_TASK_DEBUGGER=True ansible-playbook -i hosts site.yml
```

Then every **failed** task opens the debugger unless a role, play, block or task disables it. Use the `debugger` keyword for finer control.
